Figures describe the Courchevel valley (with La Tania). Search summary of Courchevel guides (theslopeguide, where-to-ski, sno): 150 km of pistes and 58 lifts; the 3 Vallées 'in figures' page gives 62 lifts for Courchevel. Lift types and capacity for Courchevel alone were not found. A 3 Vallées/S3V press document listed 71 lifts (1 cable car, 14 gondolas, 24 chairlifts, 21 drag lifts, 11 carpets/rope tows); that is neither the 3 Vallées total nor clearly Courchevel-only (S3V also runs lifts on the Méribel-Mottaret side — reference), so it is not used here. Linked Les 3 Vallées area (official 'in figures' page, search summary): 600 km of pistes, 334 pistes (53 green, 136 blue, 108 red, 37 black), 161 lifts, of which the summary itemised 34 gondolas, 3 cable cars, 57 chairlifts and 33 drag lifts (the other 34 not broken down); Wikipedia puts total uplift at about 284,500 skiers/hour in 2026 (estimate).

character: Courchevel is a set of villages — 1850, Moriond (1650), Village (1550) and Le Praz (1300), with neighbouring La Tania — on the eastern side of Les 3 Vallées, with about 150 km of its own pistes. It links to Méribel over La Saulire and on to Val Thorens and Les Menuires in the 600 km 3 Vallées area, and Courchevel 1850 is one of the Alps' best-known upmarket resorts.
